title: a bundle produced by one SDK verifies under axon-verify built from another SDK
documentation_only_reason: This case is an authoritative description of the Week 3 cross-SDK parity matrix. The actual runnable assertions live in per-SDK integration tests (see producer_sdks → notes). Vector-driver files MUST treat documentation_only=true as a skip rather than a missing handler.
description:
RFC 001 §5.4 requires that a receipt bundle produced by any SDK verify cleanly under the canonical Rust axon-verify binary. Each SDK emits a canonical 2-invocation bundle (one root, one scalar successor) signed with Ed25519, then spawns axon-verify against the temporary directory. Exit 0 plus 'chain verified' establishes byte-level parity for every wire-facing encoder (identity, causal context, invocation bytes, receipt bytes) with the Rust reference. A tamper control that changes one hex digit in a receipt signature MUST produce a non-zero exit.

The release-blocking consumers are:
  - sdk/python/tests/test_cross_language_verify.py
  - sdk/go/axon/invocation/cross_language_verify_test.go
  - sdk/node/tests/cross-language-verify.test.mjs
  - sdk/java/src/test/java/run/axon/sdk/invocation/CrossLanguageVerifyTest.java
  - sdk/swift/Tests/AxonSDKTests/CrossLanguageVerifyTests.swift
  - sdk/rust/tests/verify_binary.rs and sdk/rust/tests/verify_end_to_end.rs

tamper_control.action: flip last hex digit of inv-a receipt[1].callee_signature_hex

notes: This case does not attempt the inverse matrix. Rust's axon-verify is the canonical conformance reference; parity is established when it accepts every SDK producer.

The producer bundle recipe is shared across all six per-SDK tests by convention, not by a shared fixture file — each SDK's test constructs the same scenario using its own axiom + bundle modules. If the recipe drifts in one SDK, the Rust verifier will catch it as a signature / chain-walk failure.

consumers.loader_rule: This critical vector is not optional. The listed tests are the release-blocking consumers for the contract pinned here.
